description: REQUIRES prior nhis_edi__session__login call with same account_link_id. Get detailed info of a selected premium notice. For an authenticated call, generate and save request_idempotency_key before the first request. Reuse it with the same arguments only to recover that request after a lost response; use a new key for a new execution. Without it, calling again remains a new request. This optional key is not available to anonymous taste calls.
